Crafted from luxurious Muga silk, this saree showcases a natural lustre, rich texture, and elegant drape. Perfect for weddings, grand celebrations, festive occasions, and cultural gatherings.

items.name: Royal Kingkhap Muga Mekhela Chador
items.description: Woven from 100% pure wild Muga silk endemic exclusively to the Brahmaputra valley. Adorned with heritage Kingkhap motifs originally reserved for the Ahom royalty, woven with pure gold zari thread across 195 intense loom hours by Sualkuchi master artisans.

items.name: Ahom Bridal Crimson & Ivory Paat Silk Ensemble
items.description: An unforgettable bridal masterpiece crafted from heirloom mulberry Paat silk. Luminous white body illuminated by heavy antique gold Guna zari work and rich crimson resham embroidery. Designed for the discerning Assamese bride seeking timeless royalty.

items.name: Natural Earth Hand-Spun Eri Ahimsa Silk Chador
items.description: 100% cruelty-free Ahimsa Eri silk, where cocoons are naturally vacated by the silk moth before hand-spinning. Possesses wool-like isothermal warmth in winter and cool linen drape in summer. Features delicate indigenous tribal diamond borders.

items.name: Sualkuchi Heritage Vintage Gold Muga Saree
items.description: A rare 6.5-meter classic Muga silk saree. Featuring an elaborate woven pallu portraying the flora and wildlife of the Brahmaputra plains with fine gold wire zari. Naturally resilient and famously outlasts generations.

items.name: Ahom Bridal Crimson & Ivory Paat Silk Ensemble
items.description: An unforgettable bridal masterpiece crafted from heirloom mulberry Paat silk. Luminous white body illuminated by heavy antique gold Guna zari work and rich crimson resham embroidery. Designed for the discerning Assamese bride seeking timeless royalty.

items.name: Royal Kingkhap Muga Mekhela Chador
items.description: Crafted from 100% pure wild Muga silk endemic exclusively to the Brahmaputra valley. Adorned with heritage Kingkhap motifs traditionally worn by the Ahom nobility, woven with pure antique gold zari across 195 meticulous loom hours.
